evidence.outcome: The invalid Save Create controls are underscore aliases; Factorio 2.0.77 uses hyphenated control IDs such as copper-ore and enemy-base.
Space Age controls exist in the installed data but current UI is limited to a fixed Nauvis-style model and cannot safely represent per-surface controls.
The create flow correctly separates --map-gen-settings and --map-settings; only serializer IDs need P0 repair.
Enabled Infinite Resources mod does not cause the invalid control ID failure.

next_slice.summary: Implement P0 hyphenated control-ID serialization with regression coverage. Create queued backlog tasks for catalog-driven Space Age settings, verified advanced settings, mod settings, exchange strings, and map preview feasibility.

result: P0 Save Create failure is caused by invalid underscore autoplace IDs. P1 Space Age settings need a version-and-enabled-mod control catalog before expanding UI; backlog priorities and acceptance criteria are defined.
